description:
It tells the story of Kim MoMi who has a great body but an unattractive face. She dreamed of becoming a celebrity, but she gave up because of her face. She lives as an office worker during the day and is the 'BJ Mask Girl" at night.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=660366), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=1881890)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0000407), [Thai](https://www.webtoons.com/th/drama/mask-girl/list?title_no=1491), [T.Chinese](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/thriller/jiamianlvlang/list?title_no=648), [S.Chinese](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/episodeList?titleNo=649), [Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/thriller/mask-girl/list?title_no=7337) 

***Note**: This webtoon has been adapted into a **Korean Drama** on August 18, 2023.*
